answer.says: One, please. The samosa is a dialectic of the flaky and the hot; I shall not refuse it while it is on offer.
answer.thought: Ramesh offers the samosa, a small concession to the body's needs that I accept with gratitude. The chai will steady me for the intellectual labour of the Lindner letter, and the samosa will keep the spirit from growing too thin in the heat.
